_comment: Hand-picked GitHub projects for the TorrentShopNX homebrew store. Being in this list = approved. Fields: repo, asset (glob, optional), name/title/category/description (optional), description_i18n, depends, dest (single .nro), zip_root, prerelease. Built by scripts/homebrew_indexer.py into homebrew.json.
